newsitem.title: TUNISIA: TUNIS BOURSE INDEX CLOSES ALMOST UNCHANGED.
newsitem.headline: TUNIS BOURSE INDEX CLOSES ALMOST UNCHANGED.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange on Wednesday closed almost unchanged in lower trade, bourse sources said.
The market index closed at 599.14 from 599.78 on Tuesday.
Trade volume was 1.53 million dinars from 26.26 million dinars.
BNA bank was down 0.96 dinars to 31.02 dinars. Retail stores Monoprix MONO.TN eased 1.27 dinar to 43.75 dinars. ($=0.98 dinar)
